description: This Java class 'ExternalBusinessEventConfigurationServiceImpl' provides an implementation for configuring external business event settings within the Fineract project. It primarily interacts with the ExternalEventConfigurationRepository to determine if a specific BusinessEvent is enabled for external posting.

classes.name: ExternalBusinessEventConfigurationServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation of ExternalBusinessEventConfigurationService that checks if external events are configured for specific business events.

methods.name: isExternalEventConfiguredForPosting
methods.description: Checks whether a given BusinessEvent is enabled for external posting by querying the repository for its configuration.
